prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 30 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1479; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The injury does not fit the crash: the impact was very light, yet the claimed injury is severe.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presents following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with ongoing neck and low back strain. Over the course of 30 visits, care has consisted of manual therapy, progressive range-of-motion and stabilization exercises, and periodic reassessment. Reported symptoms have been consistent across visits, and the patient has been compliant with the home program. Palpation reveals paraspinal muscle tenderness and mild guarding in the cervical and lumbar regions, and some provocative maneuvers reproduce pain, while several other neurological and orthopedic screening tests are within normal limits. The patient describes the impact as minor, and the severity of the reported complaints appears greater than the mechanism of injury would typically predict. Treatment has extended somewhat beyond the typical course for this type of strain. No prior injury to the cervical or lumbar region is documented in available records. Billing reviewed for this episode reflects single charges for each service without duplication. Prognosis is guarded to fair, with continued reassessment planned.
